---

A simple little mod to go along with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Furry Overhaul Mod[/url]﻿ made by the community. I mean, Alex is an ex-Gridball Jock! Sure, he exercises, but he only lifts - do you ever see him do any cardio? And all he does is wander slightly outside his house, whilst his grandma's inside baking cookies all day...easy country living had to catch up with him sooner or later.

He's got a muscle-gut look going on - whilst he's no longer able to button that letterman jacket of his, he still proudly wears it, with a white shirt underneath.

Whether he's destined to become a thicc linebacker, or a couch potato cheering on the team amidst a sea of nachos and beer, is up to you... ;)

This mod is designed to work with the Content Patcher version of the furry mod. To install, simply drag the files into your mod folder, and agree to the overwrite.

There's also a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2345]Soft Sebastian[/url], if you're interested.
